title: Synchronize production assets and preflight cloud score publishing
description:
As a curator, I want Apricity to synchronize tracked sample manifests and media to production and reject unresolved score assets before publication, so every cloud score can compile and play.

Definition of done:
- `apricity sample import --from <repository>` performs an additive production asset sync with upload/reporting.
- Cloud score create/update resolves every sample and clip before mutation.
- Mushroom Jazz score references resolve and play in production.
- Automated tests cover import planning and preflight failure/success behavior.
